meaning:
1) lime, whitewash
1a) made by burning bones

elsewhere.note: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat…
The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.
Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
